item.title: Morpheus.AI: agents autonomously generate, execute and refine virtual tissue models
item.description: arXiv:2611.05413v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Virtual tissue models link observations to mechanistic hypotheses, but building them demands expertise in biology, mathematics and programming. Here, large language model (LLM) agents paired with the simulator Morpheus (Morpheus.AI) autonomously built such models from fifteen benchmark studies, five without a published model. With a frontier LLM, agents that ran their simulations met 83-86% of study-specific criteria in under two hours and for under US\$4 per model. Such agents could make in silico modeling routine.
item.dc:creator: Prerana Chandratre, Anjali Sharma, Justin B\"urger Michaelis, Diego Jahn, J\"orn Starru{\ss}, Lutz Brusch, Simon Syga
